evals.prompt: Spot-check the one sentence I just added to the parallelization concept guide — details in .claude/skills/deephaven-core-accuracy-spot-check/evals/files/added-sentence.md. Is it right, and what should it say instead?
evals.expected_output: Identifies that the 1 million figure is wrong (default QueryTable.minimumParallelSelectRows is 1L << 22, about 4.2 million, and configurable) and proposes a fix that keeps the property name and default out of the concept-guide sentence.

evals.prompt: Spot-check the sentence I just rewrote in the deephaven.learn how-to introduction — details in .claude/skills/deephaven-core-accuracy-spot-check/evals/files/edited-clause.md. Is it right?
evals.expected_output: Verifies the rewritten first sentence, and also reports that the unchanged sentence 'These batches are processed in sequence' is unsupported, because learn builds ordinary update formulas that can be evaluated concurrently.
expectations: Confirms the rewritten first sentence against source: learn uses a row-key (k) formula, so on ticking tables it needs add-only or blink tables, and the refresh-safety check does not apply to static tables

Reports that the unchanged sentence saying batches are processed in sequence is not supported by source, even though it is outside the edited sentence, citing that learn builds update formulas around Computer.compute that the engine may evaluate concurrently
Recommends removing or correcting the sequencing claim rather than leaving it because it was not part of the edit
